大陸東に位置する島国ヒノトの中央〜南部。 ヒノトは漁業・林業を中心とした: Central and southern Hinoto, an island nation east of the continent. This small country's main trades are fishing and forestry. The sea has spared it major wars, giving it a peaceful history. Many small islands dot the south; their complex currents create renowned fishing grounds.
ヒノトの中央〜北部。ヒノトの北部はきびしい自然から定住する者が少なく、未だに古: Central and northern Hinoto. The harsh north has few settlers. Many remote areas still follow ancient legends and customs. Azuma is the capital, but as dragon transport develops, the port city of Hamana is drawing away its trade and activity.
大陸東部に広がる巨大な帝政国家。「いざなえる巨竜」のふたつ名にふさわしく、ドラ: A vast empire in the eastern continent, known as the Beckoning Giant Dragon. It rose to power by using dragons to annex neighboring states. Its ruler is Emperor Chenyin of the Yellow Heart. His personal dragon troops, the Imperial Soldiers, wield independent authority and police the country harshly.
大陸北部に広がる、雪と氷におおわれた巨大国家。国土は広いが点在する自治区同士: A vast northern land of snow and ice. Its scattered autonomous regions have little contact; it feels more like a collection of villages than a nation. The people are generally simple and gentle, but the harsh climate gives them a troubled love for their homeland. They can be stern toward outsiders.
女王が治めるげんしゅくなクインズランドと、大陸文化のにない手として自由な気風が: Solemn, queen-ruled Queensland and free-spirited Sarikas, a center of continental culture, have fought many wars. In recent years, balanced dragon forces encouraged cooperation. But unstable ley lines now threatens Queensland, which has invaded again, plunging Sarikas into war.
かつては暗黒の荒野として恐れられた不毛の大陸だが、入植まもなく発見された鉱山と: Once feared as a barren, dark wilderness, this continent flourished after settlers discovered mines and rare, fierce dragons. It has since become an independent nation. Conflicts with native peoples, rampant banditry, and increasingly frequent ley-line disasters are steadily worsening public safety.
大陸南方にある南方コノモ領に属する美しい島国。かつては独自の文化をもつ壮大な: A beautiful island nation south of the continent, under Southern Konomo's rule. A great kingdom with a unique culture once stood here; only crumbling ruins remain. The center, ringed by highlands, is still mysterious. Some say ruins left by a god await the world's rebirth there.
世界各地のテイマー達がその実力を示す為におとずれる国際的な闘技場。 実力: An international arena where Tamers from across the world prove their skill. Strong Tamers can face fierce dragons, so they receive the right to travel freely between nations to protect the peace. However, the trials are real battles, and deaths are not uncommon.
